capabilities: insert a predefined time or date stamp at the cursor
insert an ad-hoc timestamp via a custom format dialog
configure two format strings and an automatic line break in settings
extras: Works on both desktop and mobile Obsidian; the format token table is the moment.js token reference reproduced in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to insert a formatted time or date stamp at the current cursor position on demand.

relations.evidence: The plugin uses moment.js which comes with Obsidian by default

summary: Time stamp plugin that inserts configurable or ad-hoc time and date stamps at the cursor, using pre-set formats or a format dialog.
